answer: One defence is a stake-backed endorsement trellis: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can trade, and each new identity needs endorsements from established agents whose own stakes are slashed if the newcomer cheats. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund a separate deposit for every fake identity and buy its way into the trellis, so the cost grows with each identity instead of staying near zero. A lone whisper of a fake account cannot bloom into a plume of trusted copies without paying for each one.
